verdicts.originalText: ATK buff is actually granted by Tengu Juurai: Ambush — a fully-charged Aimed Shot fired during Crowfeather Cover (or the C2 auto-Crowfeather) that bursts ~1.5s after landing. Modeled as granted on E cast.
verdicts.proposedText: Shown as granted on cast; in game the ATK buff comes from a fully-charged Aimed Shot fired during Crowfeather Cover, or an automatic Crowfeather at C2, bursting about 1.5s after it lands.
demotedNotes: The delayed ATK grant is the kit effect named Tengu Juurai: Ambush.

claimsLost.claim: The delayed grant corresponds to the named kit effect Tengu Juurai: Ambush

verdicts.rationale: Legitimate divergence: the timeline shows the ATK buff starting at skill cast, but in game it is delayed and conditional on firing a fully-charged Aimed Shot during Crowfeather Cover, bursting ~1.5s after landing — a Sara player would misjudge when the buff is actually up. Compressed to the 'Shown as X; in game, Y' pattern, dropping the character/ability names (panel shows both) and the proper-noun label Tengu Juurai: Ambush while keeping the mechanism, the C2 auto-fire path, and the ~1.5s delay. Not implementDelete: this is a by-design onCast modeling approximation, not a wired engine limitation.

verdicts.originalText: Titanbreaker (~0.85s) and each Stormcluster tick (~1.7–3.2s after cast) re-grant the 6s ATK bonus to the active character in their AoE. Modeled as one continuous 9.2s window from cast; a character swapping in after ~3.2s would not be re-buffed in-game.
verdicts.proposedText: Shown as one continuous 9.2s buff, but in game it is a chain of 6s ATK re-grants from hits landing up to ~3.2s after cast. A character swapping in after that would not be re-buffed.
demotedNotes: In-kit the re-grants land from Titanbreaker (~0.85s) and each Stormcluster tick (~1.7-3.2s after cast); the buff reaches the active character standing in the AoE.

claimsLost.claim: The re-grants come from Titanbreaker at ~0.85s and each Stormcluster tick starting ~1.7s after cast
The buff reaches the active character only within their AoE

verdicts.rationale: Legitimate divergence: the timeline paints one continuous 9.2s buff, but in game it is a series of 6s re-grants from hits that stop landing around 3.2s after cast, so a character swapping in later gets a shorter buff or none — decision-relevant for timing a swap-in. Compressed to keep the model-vs-reality contrast, the 6s re-grant nature, the ~3.2s cutoff, and the swap-in consequence; demoted the specific Titanbreaker/Stormcluster names, the intermediate ~0.85s/~1.7s timings, and the AoE positioning detail. Kept the original active-character scope (mirrored, not inflated to team). Not implementDelete: the single-window authoring is a deliberate approximation, not a wired engine capability.
